observations: No new photos were provided after the seller reply.
The original photos still only show the top/lid area; the underside/base and full sealing surfaces are not shown clearly enough to verify leak-tightness or food-grade status.

identity.kind: plastic water drum (food-grade style) / water storage barrel

claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show an empty-looking blue plastic drum with lid and top cap.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Photos do not clearly show any food-grade certification/label or readable food-grade marking.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Seller claims testing, but no new photo/video proof is provided; photos do not show underside/base or a leak test.

risks.risk: Underside/base damage or hairline cracks not visible in the photos (common leak point).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full bottom/underside and the drum standing on a flat surface (no wobble), plus a close-up of any seams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used drum with unknown leak condition (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-tight).

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket condition (top bung and lid fit) may be worn, causing slow leaks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lid edge and the red bung/cap showing the sealing surface; video of the bung being tightened and then a short drip check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing gasket/extra sealing (worst case: assume seal may not be reliable).

risks.risk: Food-grade claim may be unproven; drum could have been used for non-food chemicals previously.
risks.proof: Photo of any certification/food-grade marking label on the drum (clear text) or a receipt/label close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a general water drum (worst case: not confirmed food-grade).

risks.risk: Capacity/size mismatch affects value (drums vary by liters).
risks.proof: A photo where the capacity/weight marking is fully readable (front text/number) or a tape-measure shot of height and diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely size for this type until capacity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Please send new photos: (1) full underside/base, (2) close-up of the lid/bung sealing surface, (3) any label showing food-grade/certification, (4) a clear shot where the capacity/size marking is readable.
If possible, send a short video of a fill-and-wait test (show no dripping after a few minutes).
response.reason: The seller’s statement that it was tested is not verifiable remotely without new evidence. The original photos still don’t show the underside/base or readable food-grade/capacity details, so pricing confidently isn’t possible yet.
